# tenarium_api_key (Resource)

An API key, scoped to a tenant or (without `tenant_id`) platform-wide. API keys are immutable: every change creates a new key and revokes the old one. Destroying the resource revokes the key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A tenant key for the customer's CI. Changing any argument rotates the key.
resource "tenarium_api_key" "ci" {
  tenant_id  = tenarium_tenant.acme.id
  name       = "ci"
  roles      = ["admin"]
  expires_in = "2160h" # 90 days
}

# A platform-wide key (no tenant_id).
resource "tenarium_api_key" "billing_sync" {
  name  = "billing sync"
  roles = ["admin"]
}

output "ci_api_key" {
  value     = tenarium_api_key.ci.key
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.
- `roles` (Set of String) Roles granted to the key (tenant roles for tenant keys, platform roles for platform keys).

### Optional

- `expires_in` (String) Lifetime as a Go duration such as `720h`. Omit for a key that does not expire.
- `tenant_id` (String) ID (or slug) of the tenant the key belongs to. Omit for a platform key.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry time (RFC 3339), if any.
- `id` (String) API key ID.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The secret key. The API returns it only once, at creation; it is empty after import.
- `prefix` (String) Non-secret key prefix shown in listings.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Tenant key / platform key. The secret cannot be imported.
terraform import tenarium_api_key.ci <tenant_id>/<key_id>
terraform import tenarium_api_key.billing_sync <key_id>
```
